scope: Only active when body has desert-theme class or localStorage yamb_theme is desert.

packs.description: Original sculpted desert background with dunes, wind-carved sand, sun and sandstone relief.

The bottom room row from Daily Challenge through Rules now uses a dedicated restrained Desert Soft Clay Relief 3D pack. Remaining main-menu icon groups keep their current Desert treatment until their separate redesign steps.

Five professional matte-clay icons for Daily Challenge, Leaderboard, Statistics, Settings and Rules. They use sandstone, cream, terracotta and muted turquoise without jewelry, gemstones, ornate gold or Easter motifs; their 44x44 slots, positions, click geometry and sequential 8.4-second wave motion exactly match the Easter Theme Pack.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Daily Challenge intro plus room, task, already-played, completion and rewarded-video Soft Clay assets. Layout, spacing and visual dimensions match the proven Easter room parameters while all game logic remains shared and unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Top List intro, Desert header and Global/Local icons, empty/loading state, themed list contrast and shared neutral YotB gold/silver/bronze podium medals. Waiting Top 3 uses the same podium and state system.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Statistics intro; Desert header, overview, record, games, result, average, trophies, ducats, All-Time PTS, H2H and empty-state Soft Clay assets; plus separate lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak gold/silver/bronze podium mini-packs.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Settings intro plus Desert header, profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy Soft Clay assets. Switches, theme select, name field, Google account data, language flags, links and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Global Chat intro plus a standalone 44px main-menu icon, Desert room-header icon, centered send icon and empty/loading state illustration. Close, character counter, online indicator, report control, avatars and chat logic remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Online Players intro plus Desert main-menu/header icon, Add Friend, Watch Match and Challenge to Duel action icons, muted unavailable variants, infinite progressive player list, name search filter and empty/loading state. Status colors, avatars, player data and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert YotB QL intro and watermark; Desert Liga, Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions tab icons; six persistent rank badges from Amateur through Titan plus All Time; and a complete Desert QL gold, silver and bronze podium set used in rankings, Hall of Fame and quarter-end notifications.
Sandstone-and-glass board, dice, score cells, HUD and controls without changing board dimensions.
Cards, typography, inputs, modals, notifications, chat, treasury, stats, rules and leaderboard contrast.
Splash, quote, waiting and game-over screens with the same desert visual language.
Soft dune-rise, glass-glint, hover and waiting motion with reduced-motion fallback.
Desert-styled loading, empty and fallback states.
Procedural warm desert-glass cues for click, roll, score, announce, win, error and trophy.
Final screenshot set: splash, quote, main menu, board, leaderboard, settings, stats, treasury, chat, waiting and game-over.

rules: Do not change global theme icons as the base game style.
Keep all Desert Glass styling isolated under body.desert-theme.

The bottom room row from Daily Challenge through Rules uses clean standalone 44x44 Soft Clay Relief icons with the same layout and dimensions as Easter, but a restrained sandstone/terracotta/turquoise palette and no decorative backplates or kitsch ornament.

The five Desert bottom-room icons use the same staggered 8.4-second wave as Easter: only the visible icon moves, while button positions and click targets remain fixed; reduced-motion disables the animation.
Daily Challenge uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, large-icon dimensions, title spacing and left-to-right letter wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, colors and background.
Inside Daily Challenge, use the Desert room, task, already-played, completion and rewarded-video icons without changing dice, scoring, timer, reward amount or functional controls.
Top List uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but the Desert leaderboard icon, background and palette.
Inside Top List, use Desert Global, Local and empty/loading assets while keeping week/month/all-time filters textual and preserving avatars, names, scores, ordering and data-source logic.
Use the shared neutral YotB leaderboard podium medals for the first three places in both the Top List and Waiting Top 3; only surrounding surfaces and rank-number contrast follow the Desert palette.
Statistics uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Statistics, use Desert Soft Clay category and H2H assets plus dedicated lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak podium sets, while preserving graphs, progress bars, values, POB/NER/POR semantic colors, swipe behavior, card dimensions and ranking logic.
Settings uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Settings, use Desert Soft Clay icons for profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy while preserving SRB/ENG flags, switches, theme select, name input, Google account data, links and close control.
Global Chat uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, icon/title dimensions and wave as Easter, with a standalone 44px Desert room icon aligned to the Online Players card edge.

Inside Global Chat, use Desert Soft Clay header, send and empty/loading icons while preserving close, character counter, online indicator and status dot, report control, avatars, message layout and chat logic.
Online Players uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Online Players, keep the Easter search-filter position and dimensions, progressively render the complete live player list, fit long full names without changing avatar/action slots, and use Desert Soft Clay Add Friend, Watch Match, Challenge to Duel and empty/loading assets while preserving semantic player status colors and all socket actions.

Quarterly League uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, YotB QL logo dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, with the Desert logo used consistently as the main-menu watermark, room header and quarter-winner mark.

Inside Quarterly League, use Desert Liga, Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions icons; persistent Amateur, Pro, Master, Legend, Titan and All Time badges; and the Desert QL podium medals while preserving real progress, points, rank names, avatars, pagination dots, swipe, infinite progressive lists and reward logic.
Do not change game board/card dimensions or layout unless explicitly requested.
Desert background is separate from translucent glass treatments used only on UI elements.
Keep contrast readable on all light sand and glass surfaces.
